title: Gemini CLI extension manifest (gemini-extension.json) as generated by this repository
description: Maintained here. Derived from the Gemini CLI extension reference (https://geminicli.com/docs/extensions/reference/; mcpServers and ${extensionPath} checked 2026-10-14, settings checked 2026-10-22) and the manifest in github.com/microsoft/skills. Skill loading from extensions depends on the Gemini CLI version; see docs/platform-compatibility.md.

settings.description: Values Gemini CLI asks for when the extension is installed and passes to its MCP servers as the named environment variables. Sensitive values go to the system keychain.
